items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: It was just the guy who was playing piano at the Nickelodeon.

ctx.x: In other words, if Hawkins didn't know him, you wouldn't have known it was Jelly Roll. It was just the guy who was playing piano at the Nickelodeon. Yeah, but they gave you their job because they owned the Nickelodeon. They used to go to their sister's house. Their niece and their nephews and all, they all was like a kind of a family. They weren't a couple of pretty family brothers. Look at these Hawkins brothers. They were very fair.
And Lowe was walked in the door, stooped over all that money. He was very young. Jelly was very young. My brother was very young.
